name: Versace Eros
description: The ultimate fragrance for the bold, passionate, and confident man.

name: Fragranza Olio's
description: High-quality, long-lasting perfume design to project a confident and charismatic aura.
scentNotes: Refreshing mint leaves, zesty lemon, and crisp green apple.

name: Can Can
description: A wonderfully sexy, sugary, and fruity-floral blend that feels remarkably feminine.
scentNotes: Juicy nectarine and sweet clementine flower.

name: Dark Addiction
description: An accessible, budget-friendly option that mirrors the magnetic energy of high-end scents like Dior Sauvage.
scentNotes: Fresh, vibrant burst of citrus laced with an intriguing hint of mystery.

name: Ariana Grande
description: A light, cozy, and dreamy blend that feels like a warm embrace on a chilly day
scentNotes: Alluring lavender blossom, forbidden juicy pear, and fresh bergamot

name: Valaya
description: An expensive high-end "clean laundry" aesthetic that transforms into an intimate, second-skin aroma.
scentNotes: Radiant aldehydes, sweet white peach, crisp mandarin orange and bergamot.
